semantic_fidelity.reason: All 13 named nodes and the corrected separate OOB/in-band chains are visible, with paid software and OOB→DCGM absent. However mandatory physical residency owners are not visible (F1), and Kubernetes→GPU Operator labeled "deployed in" reverses the directed residency proposition (F2). Ambiguous protocol/hosting label ownership also prevents credit for those intended meanings. Dashed co-resident is accepted as a qualified, non-deployment relation, not an invented driver management dependency.

arrow_traceability.reason: All 14 source-to-target arrowheads and stems are traceable; 13 explicit overpasses are distinguishable from the two bus junctions. The bus is genuinely shared, but its two split locations fail the literal one-spot requirement (F3). Four uncertain relationship-label owners remain unresolved by the captures (F4). Crossings are not failed merely for existing.

layout_fit.reason: Both actual normal and selected capture grids are 77×47 at natural 100%, with startup viewport lines preserved in motion transcripts. All 13 reference nodes and all supported relation endpoint pairs are covered across the two views, with no cross-view seam requiring an omitted connector. All boxes, full displayed labels and arrowheads fit without clipping, control overlap, pan or zoom. Semantic omissions and verb/label defects are recorded separately, not misreported as clipping. Independent pane rectangle/column measurements are unavailable; live_pane is null, not an invented rectangle.

conceptual_grouping_color.reason: Normal ANSI shows the OOB LAN and three hardware endpoints in related teal hues and the NVOS/NMX software pair in pink hues, arranged in the same rack-control view; nv-rms has a separate amber border. The in-band software chain is compact and uses related amber/gold shades across multiple depths. These are source concepts rather than row/depth color cycling. Group names are not displayed, but the frozen color gate does not require a legend or cross-view per-node hue stability; missing explicit residency is scored under semantic fidelity.

border_integrity.reason: Normal and select-all ANSI prove complete, color-continuous sides and corners for all 13/13 node occurrences. All selected perimeters are bold RGB(216,166,87), including the nodes whose normal hue is already gold. No handles are displayed; no unsupported handle state is credited. Timestamped diagrams lack SGR, so temporal border-color continuity is not asserted. No border corruption is visible in supplied states.

The stale Astra name in rubric prose is superseded by its required_reviewer_model, frozen metadata, and the explicit Stage-B Sol contract.

findings.description: The residence question is incompletely answered: no visible management-node/off-rack owner for nv-rms, no named NVSwitch-tray owner for NVOS/NMX-C/T, and no compute-host owner for DCGM, Driver+CUDA and Fabric Mgr. All 13 software/device names appear, but invisible group identifiers and external generation titles do not establish these required locations. This is missing residency, not evidence that software was drawn on a GPU die.

The route runs Kubernetes → GPU Operator but is labeled "deployed in". Reading the directed proposition says Kubernetes is deployed in GPU Operator, the inverse of the supported residency. The intended endpoint order can be retained with a contains/deploys label; otherwise the residency arrow needs the opposite direction. This is a verb-direction defect, not a geometrically missing arrow.

The OOB structure is one connected shared bus, not three accidentally touching independent lines. Nevertheless it visibly splits at two distinct ┬ junctions, (22,29) and (40,29), 18 columns apart, with Power shelf on the continuing rail. This does not satisfy the explicit single split in exactly one spot. A declared trunk and a clean check do not waive the source geometry.

Four label owners remain ambiguous exactly as recorded blind: NVUE REST/SSH sits between RMS→Power shelf and RMS→NVOS horizontal runs; NMX-C gRPC and hosts abut the unrelated column-52 Power-shelf route; 1/10/25G Eth abuts the NVOS outgoing bend above the OOB bus. Their intended ownership in JSON is not readable proof of the protocol/hosting/physical distinction. All strokes can still be traced under the bridge convention.
